ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Camera and Microphone Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Processes accessing the camera and microphone from suspicious folder

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\CapabilityAccessManager\\\\ConsentStore\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\NonPackaged.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*microphone.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*webcam.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\:\\#Windows\\#Temp\\#.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\:\\#\\$Recycle\\\.bin\\#.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\:\\#Temp\\#.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\:\\#Users\\#Public\\#.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\:\\#Users\\#Default\\#.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\:\\#Users\\#Desktop\\#.*")))
